approvalRule: A recommendation is not an approval. Only Carl's explicit response may set a decision to approved.
approvalSource: Carl explicitly approved the recommended release path and directed completion.

decisions.label: First release profile
decisions.reason: The static profile can exclude live Jolene, contact intent, and the avatar while those production operations and art gates remain open.

decisions.label: Lead professional title
decisions.reason: It most directly joins Carl's demonstrated product, interface, systems, and engineering work without reducing him to visual design.

decisions.label: Primary opportunity
decisions.reason: It keeps the hiring path unmistakable while allowing high-value collaboration without presenting the site as an agency pitch.

decisions.label: Dedicated About route
decisions.reason: A dedicated route gives the creative-technologist-to-product-engineer story room without overloading the homepage.

decisions.label: LinkedIn recommendation publication
decisions.reason: All 13 received recommendations have exact-text and attribution reconciliation, and Carl explicitly approved publication of the complete set.

decisions.label: Recommendation indexing
decisions.reason: Indexing is professionally useful only after Carl approves the exact public recommendation set and takedown path.

decisions.label: Historical work treatment
decisions.reason: A small archive preserves career depth while keeping current product engineering as the first impression.

decisions.label: First archive candidate
decisions.reason: Carl approved archival display of the historical project visuals on August 27, 2026. yU+co remains the lead record with a privacy-safe crop and explicit team attribution.

decisions.label: Teaching evidence
decisions.reason: The supported 2012 programming-instruction and Scratch claim adds mentoring evidence. Classroom photographs remain private unless consent and image rights are established.

decisions.label: Jolene and avatar in first release
decisions.reason: The UI and local contract are strong, but public service operations and the approved avatar master do not exist yet.

decisions.label: Production origin
decisions.reason: No custom domain was supplied, so the managed hosting origin is the approved release origin; a custom domain can be attached later without changing the content model.

decisions.label: Deployment authorization
decisions.reason: Deployment authorization must follow, not replace, production-origin metadata, physical-device QA, final copy review, and rollback evidence.

nonDecisions: The portfolio never accesses private Jolene APIs, Obsidian, MCP tools, or durable memory.
Job descriptions remain untrusted ephemeral input.
Contact intent cannot autonomously email, apply, schedule, negotiate, or contact recruiters.

Ten historical project visuals are approved for bounded archival display. TASER evidence imagery and Ignite classroom photographs remain private-only unless their separate confidentiality and subject-privacy gates are cleared.
The yU+co site and team may be described as a 2006 Webby Awards Honoree; Carl may not be described as a personal Webby winner.
